text:
maya: Quick status check — runtime perf sprint: kernel micro-ops, continuous batching tweaks, KV cache warmup. Posting blockers and asks so async folks can pick up.
kevin: Can you call out the top 3 blockers? I can triage CRs today.
maya: sure — 1) kernel PR #432 is green locally but failing the canary (OOM on 8k seqs), 2) continuous batching fallback path not honoring request affinities (risking higher latency p95), 3) kv warmup race on cold starts in Dedicated envs.
liam: OOM seems like a kernel allocator edge — repro steps?
maya: repro: run perf harness `./bench --model rwd-7b --seq 8192 --batch 1` then memory spikes ~2s into generation. Attached logs:
```
I0327 14:12:01 worker.cc:234 Allocating temp buffer 1.6G
E0327 14:12:03 runtime.cc:542 Failed to reserve memory: CUDA OOM
```
kevin: thanks — I'll pick up the allocator fix, but need the failing canary job id + kernel PR link. @maya can you drop them?
maya: canary job id: `canary-2026-03-16-09` (logs in CI). PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/432
sanjay: for batching fallback — I saw p95 regressions when affinity header is dropped by the ingress. Short-term I can add a guard that tags requests with `x-rwd-affinity` header in the runtime, long-term we should propagate affinity in the router.
tara: I have a small change that fixes header preservation in the router (PR #210). It needs an infra-allocator bump (dependency: infra/allocator#78). Who owns that?
liam: infra-allocator bklog shows @ops-bot flagged it as low-priority. ops-bot, any ETA on #78?
ops-bot: Automatic notice: infra/allocator#78 currently blocking 3 PRs. Priority: medium. Assigned to: kevin_infra. Estimated ETA: 2026-03-18.
kevin: I can escalate infra bump, but will need perf tests post-merge. Can someone add a quick smoke that exercises affinity preservation?
sanjay: I'll add a smoke script and a prometheus check for `runtime_request_affinity_missing_total` to fail the job if headers drop. PR incoming by EOD.
maya: great. Ownership recap: kernel allocator fix -> @kevin (runtime); canary triage -> @kevin + @maya; batching affinity guard -> @sanjay (short-term) / router PR -> @tara; infra allocator bump -> @kevin escalate; kv warmup race -> volunteers?
tara: I can take kv warmup after router merge. Quick question: what's the kv warmup failure mode — double-warmup or null pointer?
maya: null pointer when cache entry is created concurrently and a second thread reads before fields are initialized. Repro with `--concurrency 12 --coldstart`.
kevin: ok assigned @tara for kv after router. I'll open a follow-up issue for kernel OOM with logs & heapmap.
liam: CR ping: kernel PR #432 needs one more approval (cc @liam). If anyone is free, please review small allocator change — it's low-risk but needs eyes.
maya: thanks all. If anyone is taking a task, reply here with what you'll do and ETA. I want to close top-3 by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
kevin: I'll take allocator fix + infra escalation. ETA: Thursday EOD.
sanjay: batching guard + smoke PR today.
tara: router PR review now, kv warmup after merge, ETA for both: router review today, kv warmup Friday.
liam: I'll review kernel PR this afternoon.
maya: perfect. I'll update the sprint board and add labels: `blocker/oom`, `blocker/affinity`, `blocker/kv-warmup`. If any blocker slips past Friday, we'll stand up a quick sync.
ops-bot: Reminder: canary-2026-03-16-09 re-run scheduled at 2026-03-17T18:00Z.
maya: noted. thanks team — ping here for any cross-team handoffs.
